primary_endpoint: Single-dose cohorts: AUC from 0 to infinity and Cmax. Multiple-dose cohorts: drug-related treatment-emergent adverse events.
efficacy_outcome: After 28 weeks, liver fat content, liver stiffness, liver volume, body weight, and other hepatic and metabolic markers were generally reduced; no numerical estimates or comparator were reported.
safety_signal: Drug-related adverse events occurred in 25.0% of healthy participants and ≤25.0% of participants with cirrhosis after single doses; rates in multiple-dose cohorts were 82.4% and 87.5%, respectively.
